function.name: ProductSearch_execute
function.description: Performs a search for products in the database based on specified criteria, such as keywords and filters, and returns a list of matching products. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

keywords.description: The search terms used to find products, separated by spaces.

category.description: The category to filter the search results. If no category is specified, all categories will be included in the search.

price_range.description: A price range to narrow down the search results, specified as a string in the format 'min-max' where min and max are prices in USD.

sort_order.description: The order in which the search results are sorted. Choose 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending order.

in_stock.description: A flag to filter search results to only include products that are in stock. Set to true to include only in-stock items.

message.content: Hai! Untuk membantu kamu lebih cepat, bisakah kamu beri tahu produk apa yang sedang kamu cari (misalnya merek atau nama produk)? Dengan begitu saya bisa cek ketersediaan ukuran 40 dan kapan akan ready.
message.reasoning: The user says: "Size 40 kapan ready kak". This seems like a request in Indonesian: "Size 40 kapan ready kak" meaning "When will size 40 be ready, buddy?" They likely want to know when a product of size 40 will be ready. We need to search for products with size 40? But we don't have a function to search by size. The function only allows keywords, category, price_range, sort_order, in_stock. We can use keywords "size 40" maybe. Or we can ask clarifying question. The user didn't specify product. We could ask what product they are referring to. But the instruction: "If you do not know the answer, ask clarifying question." So we should ask clarifying question: "Which product are you referring to?" Also we might ask if they want to search for availability. So we should respond asking clarifying question.
